title: The Sealed Machine
description:
In the basement of an old observatory stands a sealed machine. Whenever a list of numbers is fed into it, the machine shows a single number in return, and nobody knows why.

The rule behind its answer is hidden. Study the examples carefully, work out what the machine is doing, and reproduce its answer for any given list.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the value produced by the machine.
